name: The Farmhand
description: A sharp-tongued hired hand who stages misunderstandings and warnings to bait a confession and win his ten-dollar wager.
visualPrompt: Lean young farmhand in worn work clothes and boots, sleeves rolled, alert eyes and a sly expression, standing casually as if always one step ahead

name: The Wife
description: Restless and volatile, she hides her affair and swings between anger and sweetness as she tries to stay ahead of suspicion.
visualPrompt: Country wife in a plain dress and apron, hair pinned back, carrying a bundle under her apron, face flushed with alarm and guilt, posture tense and hurried

name: The Deaf Husband
description: A good-natured man who hears little and follows suggestions easily, unaware of the true drama unfolding around him.
visualPrompt: Broad-shouldered middle-aged farmer with simple sturdy clothing, calm puzzled expression, holding an axe or walking stick, moving heavily but not threatening

name: Pål Andrestuen
description: The wife’s lover, bold until he is spooked into fleeing by the farmhand’s planted fears.
visualPrompt: Young man in farm attire with an anxious, wide-eyed look, half-turned as if about to run, hovering near a plough by the edge of a meadow
